content: PySide6 6.10.1 probe-verified on win/offscreen: addToolBar(LeftToolBarArea) places the vertical toolbar OUTSIDE (window-edge of) the left dock column and setCorner() does not change it — so a QMainWindow toolbar cannot satisfy Pages|strip|canvas ordering. Embedding a vertical QToolBar (setOrientation Vertical, fixed width) inside a central-widget QHBoxLayout between dock and canvas produces exactly Pages | strip | canvas | panel.
